This document outlines the equipment 
 inspection I1, which must be performed annually bases as indicated by Y1 
 in the title block.
The purpose of the shaft seal pumps :

Cooling the shaft seal from high temperature which resulted 
 from operating turbine cooling the governor oil protect turbine from operating 
 water

The pump are centrifugal horizontal with redial impeller 
 and spiral casing provided with feet axial suction orifice and delivery 
 orifice in an upward position the pump is assembled to an electric 
 asynchronous 
 three phase motor by means of a flexible coupling the unite block pump motor is 
 assembled on an electro - welvedsteel base plate

Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear the safety and healthy 
 protective equipment as safety shoes, helmet .... etc
The pump is out of service

The motor disconnected from MCC & 
 control panel

Mechanical tools 
 ( complete set of manual wrench - brushes - etc)

Some special 
 spare tools (mechanical seal ball bearing etc)

Tighten hexagonal screw with a torqe 
 wrench
Check that the shaft can freely rotate by hand
Check the tightening of the suction and delivery flanges
Check that ball bearings are filled up with grease
